title: 336 prove first match for any allocated Java int array
description: Rebuild the transition proof from the released Guava method and its forwarding helper. Check all base, return, heap, safe access, signed overflow and ranking obligations. Preserve the self-contained SMT query and disassembly.
expected: The domain including maximum signed length is satisfiable. Every counterexample formula for the invariant, frame, exits and variant is unsatisfiable.

steps.name: Prove the compiled traversal by array induction
